title: Grove holds a standing authorization to swap stablecoins into USDS, bounded by a price tolerance and mandatory disclosure
content:
A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.2.1.2.3 grants a pre-approval rather than requiring case-by-case governance: "Grove is authorized to swap USD stablecoins held in the Grove SubProxy Account... to USDS. Such swaps must be executed at a rate of approximately 1:1 (**divergence not to exceed 0.1%**) and each swap must be documented in a Forum post under the 'Grove Prime' category, containing the Technical Scope... Swaps meeting these requirements may be included directly in a Grove Spell submitted to a Sky Executive Vote, **with no prior token holder vote needed**."

The interesting move is what substitutes for the vote. Governance normally exists to judge whether an action is wise; here that judgment is **replaced by an objective test**. A swap within 0.1% of par is, by construction, value-neutral — there is no discretion to review, so reviewing it would cost time and produce nothing. Grove's token holders pre-consent to the entire class of such swaps.

The tolerance is the whole safeguard. It is what prevents the authorization from becoming a licence to trade: a swap at a meaningfully off-market rate is outside the grant, so an operator taking a loss on one is acting without authority rather than merely acting badly.

Disclosure preserves auditability without adding latency. Each swap must be posted with its Technical Scope, so the community can verify compliance **after** execution rather than gating it beforehand.

The structural pattern is worth naming: **objective bright line plus mandatory publication equals safe pre-authorization**. It is the general recipe the Atlas uses to keep routine mechanical operations out of a governance process designed for discretionary ones — and it works only where a bright line genuinely exists.
description: Swaps at approximately 1:1 with divergence not exceeding 0.1%, each documented in a forum post with Technical Scope, may go straight into a Grove Spell with no prior token holder vote.
